title: Name Build checks correctly in shared-root credit diagnostics
outcome: Use the recognized check's kind label in both shared-named-root host lines in note_engram_command_started (src/engram_turn_checks.rs:1371-1379); a Build currently says 'A recognised test' and tells the agent to run its test. Credit decisions are already kind-correct. Preserve Test wording and named-root credit behavior. Related internal kind-generic comments may be broadened to check.
acceptance: Shared-root credit diagnostics correctly name a recognized Build as a build/check and do not tell the agent to run a test; Test diagnostics and credit disposition remain correct, with focused controls for both shared-root cases.
